changes.title: Save protection
changes.text: Failed save writes now preserve the existing save, nested recovery works, and failed reads close their files.

changes.title: Run comparisons
changes.text: Run comparisons now show the correct difference even for extremely large recorded values.

changes.title: Boss statistics
changes.text: Yog's summoned minions no longer count as bosses; cached tables refresh without changing run history.

changes.title: Statistics cache
changes.text: Malformed statistics caches are rejected before attempting oversized memory allocations.

changes.title: Statistics shortcut
changes.text: The statistics arrow remains visible and clickable after ten genuine runs; demo access keeps the earlier guidance.

changes.title: About APD
changes.text: About now has six compact information popups and shows the installed version and build.

changes.title: News and Changes
changes.text: News now uses dated article cards, while Changes uses build navigation and clickable sprite entries.

changes.title: Historical records
changes.text: Historical builds with missing evidence are explicitly marked incomplete instead of receiving guessed change notes.

changes.title: Statistics Home
changes.text: UIMSD Home uses compact native controls, aligned statistics and optional explanations; tap wins, deaths or abandoned runs to explore matching records.

changes.title: Native statistics menus
changes.text: Statistics pickers and run actions use Pixel Dungeon buttons, explanations open separately, numeric table values align, and Home keeps direct navigation and zero abandoned-run counts.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I focused on save protection, trustworthy statistics and clearer information screens. Older build notes remain incomplete wherever the evidence is missing.
